# Exposure

Generated from `src/rules.js`, `src/catalogue.js` and `src/engine.js` by `tools/build_docs.py`. Do not edit by hand; edit the sources and run `python3 tools/build_docs.py`. How to read an entry: [settings reference](README.md).

How bright pictures are and how Auto ISO behaves. Msetter puts these first because they are what most profiles differ in.

| Code | Name | Msetter |

| [D00C](#d00c) | Shutter Speed Limit | Slowest shutter speed |

### D00C

**Shutter Speed Limit**

Msetter: Slowest shutter speed. On A the camera never goes slower. It raises ISO instead. 1/f follows the lens: 1/50 with a 50 mm lens.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 32770 (1/(4f) s)
- Cameras: all

Numbers below 32768 are shutter speeds in 256ths of a stop faster than one second: 256 is 1/2 s, 2560 is 1/1000 s. 32768, 32769 and 32770 follow the focal length of the lens: 1/f, 1/(2f) and 1/(4f). Used by Auto ISO (M-EV1 manual p.89, M11-P manual p.101).

| Value | Camera's name | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 32770 | 1/(4f) s | Four times that: 1/200 with a 50 mm lens. Freezes movement. |
| 32769 | 1/(2f) s | Twice that: 1/100 with a 50 mm lens. Steadier. |
| 32768 | 1/f s | One over the lens length: 1/50 with a 50 mm lens. |
| 2816 | 1/2000 s |  |
| 2560 | 1/1000 s |  |
| 2304 | 1/500 s |  |
| 2048 | 1/250 s |  |
| 1792 | 1/125 s |  |
| 1536 | 1/60 s |  |
| 1280 | 1/30 s |  |
| 1024 | 1/15 s |  |
| 768 | 1/8 s |  |
| 512 | 1/4 s |  |
| 256 | 1/2 s |  |

### D00B

**Maximum ISO**

Msetter: Highest ISO. Auto ISO never goes above this.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 3200 (ISO 3200)

### D010

**M-ISO**

Msetter: ISO. Auto or one fixed ISO. On the M11-P the ISO dial uses this on M.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 12500 (ISO 12500) on the M11, M11-P, M11-D and M11 Monochrom; 0 (Auto ISO) on the M-EV1
- Cameras: all

On the M-EV1 this is the ISO. On cameras with an ISO dial it is the ISO used when the dial is set to M; the camera calls it M-ISO there (M11-P manual p.99). 0 is Auto ISO.

### 5010

**Exposure Compensation**

Msetter: Exposure compensation. Makes pictures brighter or darker than the meter suggests.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (0 EV)
- Cameras: all

Written in thousandths of a stop: -667 is -2/3 EV. The menu sets it in 1/3 stops from -3 to +3 EV (M-EV1 manual p.104).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| -3000 | -3 EV |
| -2667 | -2 2/3 EV |
| -2333 | -2 1/3 EV |
| -2000 | -2 EV |
| -1667 | -1 2/3 EV |
| -1333 | -1 1/3 EV |
| -1000 | -1 EV |
| -667 | -2/3 EV |
| -333 | -1/3 EV |
| 0 | 0 EV |
| 333 | +1/3 EV |
| 667 | +2/3 EV |
| 1000 | +1 EV |
| 1333 | +1 1/3 EV |
| 1667 | +1 2/3 EV |
| 2000 | +2 EV |
| 2333 | +2 1/3 EV |
| 2667 | +2 2/3 EV |
| 3000 | +3 EV |

### 500B

**Exposure Metering**

Msetter: Metering. How the camera measures the light.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 2 (Multi-field)
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Spot |
| 1 | Center-weighted |
| 32769 | Highlight-weighted |
| 2 | Multi-field |

### D115

**Exposure Simulation**

Msetter: Exposure preview. When the screen shows how bright the picture will be.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 4 (Shutter Button Half Pressed) on the M11, M11-P and M11 Monochrom; 1 (Permanent) on the M11-D and M-EV1
- Cameras: all

The manuals call this Exposure Preview (M-EV1 manual p.103, M11-P manual p.114).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 4 | Shutter Button Half Pressed |
| 1 | Permanent |
